not_run.two_level_touch+gff: not runnable on the real arm in either form. Behind recover_first (the MuJoCo row) the blind recovery's re-hold after its first J2 seek ran away on the real arm at 91-93 deg/s powered, every start (run real_two_level_touch_gff_*, the plant's controlled stop and the home button each time). Bare (the home button as the recovery), its first seek carries the gravity feed-forward planned for the upper stop (J2 6.6 N.m) from the hanging rest, where gravity is ~0: on the MuJoCo rung that lunges J2 to 3.4 rad/s and the sequence's own speed guard aborts it (B0 and B2, home start) - not sent to the arm.
not_run.press_reverse+gff: not run on the real arm: its second side walks J2 to -85 deg (Craig 5) and seeks J2's lower stop (CAD -90.03 = Craig ~0), below the unidentified contact the real arm meets at Craig j2 12.6 / 16.5 deg (fivebar-real-night F08, two stalls on one map; fivebar_homed.LADDER_J2_MIN_DEG 20 keeps every stage above it). It would press up to 10 N.m into that contact and define it as J2's lower stop: a guaranteed wrong zero and an unknown thing pressed. Needs the contact identified (Zach's eye at j2 ~17) or a second side that stays above j2 20.

video.caption: The real five-bar, single_touch from the c1-10 start, ×2 (D435, run real_single_touch_065618, episode 1): J2 lifts L1 onto its upper stop with the crank limp, then C1 seeks its stop with J2 pushing; the zero is defined there. The clip ends where the J2 + C1 move home met the rack's 86 °/s runaway ceiling: the plant held the arm, and the home button took it home.

verdict_html: The real rung FAILS on reliability: 0 of 16 real episodes finished. On the two rows the real arm could run (tview_v2, single_touch: 4 starts each), every stall landed within 0.12° (J2) / 0.21° (C1) of its stop's known board position and the zero repeats: spread J2 0.016° / C1 0.005° (tview_v2), J2 0.060° / C1 0.000° (single_touch), inside the 0.1° gate; the two rows agree on the real arm within 0.006° (J2) / 0.008° (C1), and their offset from each other matches the MuJoCo rung's within 0.016° (worst of B0/B1/B2), inside 0.1°. Each episode then stopped 0.1-0.2 s after the zero was defined: the first un-fed hold let the real arm (end group 22 % over CAD) drop J2 at 86-103 °/s powered, over the rack's 86 °/s runaway ceiling, so the plant held it and the home button took it home. two_level_touch+gff and press_reverse+gff did not run on the real arm (reasons below). J1 was held, never homed.
findings_html: CAN 12's board trajectory turned a re-anchored setpoint into a 91 °/s spring-off. A plain position command leaves servo.default_accel_limit (100 rev/s², CAN 12 only, records/fivebar-bench) in charge: after a seek pressed its stop the firmware walked its control position 25° back from where it was and fed that trajectory's velocity to the D term, pushing J2 off the stop at +7.7 N·m (4 of 4 starts of the first run). The real plant now sends velocity/accel limits of moteus' "none" (a plain PD, as the MuJoCo board model and PlantBackend intend); the home button's own walks (PlantBackend) still carry the default.

The blind recovery (recover_first) cannot hold the real arm. Its holds carry no gravity feed-forward at 8 N·m: with L1 near horizontal the real J2 dropped at 87 °/s (2 of 4), its step-11 define found J2 pushed 3.7° off its stop by the crank's hub (1 of 4), and one start lost a bus exchange. So every MuJoCo row, all of which ran behind recover_first, was run bare on the real arm, with the home button as the recovery (which is what sets every real start).

No-feed-forward holds and moves cannot carry the real arm's L1. tview_v2's first waypoint and single_touch's move home both begin with a hold at the stop: J2 drops (86-103 °/s) before the move can catch it. The MuJoCo twin (lighter CAD masses) also passes the ceiling in these procedures, later: 124 °/s on tview's second waypoint, 111 °/s on single_touch's move home. Either way the zero is already defined.

two_level_touch+gff has no real form. Behind recover_first it never reaches its own steps (above). Bare, its first seek carries the feed-forward planned for the upper stop (J2 6.6 N·m) from the hanging rest: MuJoCo lunges J2 to 3.4 rad/s and aborts (B0, B2), so it was not sent to the arm. The +gff feed-forward is planned for the pose a step ends at; it needs the pose the step starts from too.

press_reverse+gff not run: its second side walks J2 to Craig 5° and seeks J2's lower stop at Craig ~0°, below the unidentified contact the real arm meets at Craig 12.6-16.5° (the F08 stalls; fivebar_homed keeps every stage above Craig 20°).

The home button refuses at its own home. bam_fivebar_recovery.home.classify calls the real hanging rest (89.1, -128.2) past_straight (the branch boundary runs through home) and its settle cannot change a hanging rest: run real_rf_two_level_touch_gff_064427 ended on that refusal at home. The runner now skips a walk when the arm already rests within 2° of its target and walks the starts by fivebar_homed's board leg.

A plant close left CAN 12 in BRAKE after that refusal (the next run refused to open: "CAN 12 is in mode 15"); it read mode 0 at the release check 2 min later. Bus exchanges were lost twice in one run (6.5 per million known); each time the plant held and the home button recovered.
Encoder step: J2's zeros differ by multiples of 0.011° (360°/32768); C1 read the same stall value on every single_touch start.
